body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.63 (naive sector base rate 0.51) that: Sona BLW FY27 consolidated operating margin is >=23.0% (floor of its 23-25% band). Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5): p0 = 0.51 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'margin', all-category fallback, n=7); SAC +50.0 pts x weight 0.231 (N=6) -> p = 0.63. Evidence: Q4FY26 call (30-Apr-2026): 'now it is 23 to 25% ... we should be able to continue being in that band'; Q2FY27 (26-Oct-2026) CFO: 'around 23%'. Company EBITDA margin FY26 24.7%, H1FY27 ~23%. Screener OPM FY26 24.3%, Q1/Q2 FY27 22.5%/22.5%; XBRL read ~0.5 pp higher than screener on Q2 (scoreboard known limit). Resolution: YES if FY27 consolidated Operating Profit / Sales is >= 23.0% on both NSE XBRL and screener.in (to one decimal); if they straddle 23.0% the call goes to review and the company-reported FY27 EBITDA margin decides. Source: NSE XBRL + screener.in consolidated; Sona Q4 FY27 press release. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.51 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'margin', all-category fallback, n=7); SAC +50.0 pts x weight 0.231 (N=6) -> p = 0.63
data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 4 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'margin' promises among the other auto-component peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=7, too few in category so all-category peer rate used). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if FY27 consolidated Operating Profit / Sales is >= 23.0% on both NSE XBRL and screener.in (to one decimal); if they straddle 23.0% the call goes to review and the company-reported FY27 EBITDA margin decides.
